messages:
Arun (Sales): Hi team - need quick approval for an enterprise pilot discount. Customer 'Sparkline Health' wants Dedicated with 6mo pilot. Asking for 40% off list + $12k PS credit to migrate data (they're a strategic healthcare partner). Reseller Cloudway will manage deployment.

Morgan (Finance): 40% is above deal desk threshold. What's the expected spend after pilot and are we taking on any uplift guarantees?

Arun (Sales): Post-pilot we expect them to convert to Dedicated at $60k/mo run-rate. Pilot revenue (6mo) at list = $180k. They're willing to sign a 24mo commitment after pilot. No guaranteed uplift but high confidence from partner.

Morgan (Finance): Need run-rate math and net delta for pilot. Also we should avoid giving PS credit that counts toward committed ARR. Proposal: PS credit applied as invoice credit, separate from committed usage. Cap partner-managed infra support at $8k/mo to protect margins.

Arun (Sales): Agreed on separating credits. Partner wants credit applied up-front to offset their implementation cost.

Priya M: Also recommend milestone-based release of PS credit tied to successful cutover dates. Legal to add clawback if customer terminates before 12mo post-conversion.

Legal Bot: Policy: Discounts >35% and PS credits >$10k require CFO approval + Legal review. See /policies/discounts and /policies/partner-credits.

Morgan (Finance): Quick P&L (pilot 6mo):
```
List pilot revenue (6mo): $180,000
40% discounted revenue (6mo): $108,000
One-time PS credit: $12,000
Estimated pilot revenue delta: -$84,000
Estimated ARR if convert: $720,000/yr
```

Diego (CFO): I get the long-term upside but we need stronger controls. Approve conditional exception: 40% off for 6mo + $12k PS credit, subject to (1) signed 24mo commitment post-pilot or equivalent escrow, (2) milestone-based PS credit release, (3) partner commission capped at 10% of net ARR, (4) Legal to add 12mo clawback clause. Once Legal confirms wording I will sign exception.

Arun (Sales): Will push for the 24mo commitment and update the SOW. Will also confirm partner commission cap.

Morgan (Finance): Noted - finance will mark discount as deferred revenue impact and track via deal desk.

Legal Bot: Exception recorded: exception-id=EX-2032101112 pending-legal timestamp=2032101460
